summary: Iteration 24 — admin-managed 4-digit password-reset PIN feature verified end-to-end on BACKEND + WEB + MOBILE with a light regression on the iteration-23 email-LINK flow. Backend pytest suite (7/7 GREEN, /app/backend/tests/test_iteration24_admin_pin.py): founder has_reset_pin flag is true; POST /api/auth/reset-with-pin succeeds with founder PIN 7455 (auto sign-in access_token+user returned) and founder password was restored to Semi123! at the end of the run; admin can SET (1234), CHANGE (5678, old PIN now 403), and CLEAR (pin=null) another user's PIN — the has_reset_pin flag on GET /api/admin/users reflects each state; after 5 wrong PIN attempts the account is locked out and even the CORRECT PIN returns 429 with Retry-After header (PIN_LOCKOUT_MINUTES=15); non-admin JWTs cannot call POST /api/admin/users/{id}/reset-pin or GET /api/admin/users (403); anonymous calls return 401/403; validation is enforced (pin not \d{4} → 422, new_password < 6 → 422, unknown email → 403 no enumeration); email-LINK regression is still green (forgot-password 200 + dev_link in sandbox, reset-password consumes token once, reuse → 400, new password logs in). WEB /reset-pin renders (data-testid=reset-pin-form), submits email+PIN+new password, auto-signs the user in and redirects to /, and displays the 'Invalid email or PIN.' error state for bad PINs plus client-side short-PIN guard; /forgot-password has the working 'Have a reset PIN? Use it here' link (data-testid=forgot-use-pin) pointing at /reset-pin. MOBILE Expo web preview: /forgot-password/index renders with 'Have a reset PIN?' link, /forgot-password/pin renders (email, 4-digit PIN, new password) and on success navigates to /home fully signed-in; /admin/reset-pins loads for the founder, lists users with PIN/No-PIN badge, supports search, opens a Set/Change modal, saves the PIN (row flips to 'Change'), and REMOVE PIN button clears it (row flips back to 'Set PIN'). No critical or minor issues found in scope.
action_items: None for iteration 24 — feature is production-ready across backend + web + mobile.

PRIOR ITERATION 22 (still open, HIGH) — GET /api/conversations/{id}/typing 500 due to naive-vs-aware datetime compare in routes/messages.py:219 was NOT exercised here and remains pending fix (same pattern already used correctly in server.py:719/720 for reset-with-pin lockout).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:707 reset-with-pin correctly uses dummy hash verify + generic 403 on unknown user AND on 'no PIN set' to avoid user enumeration/timing leaks. Good.

server.py:735-738 lockout logic zeros the failed_attempts counter as soon as the lock is set — clean; the lock is enforced by comparing user['reset_pin_locked_until'].replace(tzinfo=utc) > now(), which is the correct fix pattern for Mongo's naive-UTC storage.

server.py:1517-1547 admin_set_reset_pin gates on is_super_admin only (not is_admin) — matches the requirement that only the founder can manage PINs. Considered whether regular admins should also manage PINs; product decision is founder-only per current spec.

server.py:1728-1758 seed_admin force-writes ADMIN_DEFAULT_PIN=7455 hash on every startup — matches requirement (1). Confirmed by test_founder_has_reset_pin_flag + test_founder_reset_with_fixed_pin_and_restore.
AdminSetPinBody uses pin: Optional[str] with pattern ^\d{4}$ (default None) — sending pin=null OR omitting pin both correctly clear the PIN. Verified in test_admin_set_change_clear_pin.
Frontend ResetWithPin.jsx correctly calls setSession(access_token, user) + navigate('/', replace=true) — auto sign-in works. Client-side validation blocks non-4-digit PINs before hitting the API.
Mobile app/forgot-password/pin.tsx uses setToken + refresh + router.replace('/(tabs)/home') — auto sign-in works. All inputs have testIDs and hitSlop is set on the back button.
Mobile app/admin/reset-pins.tsx surfaces a distinct 'Remove PIN' action only when has_reset_pin is true — matches admin UX intent; row list updates optimistically after save/clear.
